options.title: Building entrance
options.description: Physical entrance through which a user enters a building or facility.

options.title: Park or compound gate
options.description: Gate or opening providing access to a park, campus or other compound.

options.title: Public transport stop
options.description: Street-level boarding or alighting point for a scheduled public transport service.

options.title: Platform
options.description: Boarding area associated with one or more public transport services, usually within a stop area or station.

options.title: Station entrance
options.description: Street-level entrance providing access to a station complex and its platforms or services.

options.title: Ferry terminal access
options.description: Access point leading to a ferry terminal, pier or boarding area.

options.title: Taxi rank or pickup point
options.description: Fixed or designated location where users access a taxi, ride or pickup service.

options.title: Shared-mobility dock or pickup point
options.description: Dock, station or designated location for picking up or returning shared vehicles.

options.title: Parking entrance
options.description: Vehicle or pedestrian entrance to a parking facility.

options.title: Virtual DRT stop
options.description: Designated non-physical or lightly marked pickup or drop-off location for demand-responsive transport.

options.title: Mobility-hub access
options.description: Entrance or access node to a multimodal mobility hub or interchange.

options.title: General access node
options.description: Generic access interface used when no more specific access-point type applies.

en.#Physical entrance through which a user: Physical entrance through which a user enters a building or facility.
en.#Gate or opening providing access to a p: Gate or opening providing access to a park, campus or other compound.
en.#Street-level boarding or alighting poin: Street-level boarding or alighting point for a scheduled public transport service.
en.#Boarding area associated with one or mo: Boarding area associated with one or more public transport services, usually within a stop area or station.
en.#Street-level entrance providing access: Street-level entrance providing access to a station complex and its platforms or services.
en.#Access point leading to a ferry termina: Access point leading to a ferry terminal, pier or boarding area.
en.#Fixed or designated location where user: Fixed or designated location where users access a taxi, ride or pickup service.
en.#Dock, station or designated location fo: Dock, station or designated location for picking up or returning shared vehicles.
en.#Vehicle or pedestrian entrance to a par: Vehicle or pedestrian entrance to a parking facility.
en.#Designated non-physical or lightly mark: Designated non-physical or lightly marked pickup or drop-off location for demand-responsive transport.
en.#Entrance or access node to a multimodal: Entrance or access node to a multimodal mobility hub or interchange.
en.#Generic access interface used when no m: Generic access interface used when no more specific access-point type applies.

it.#Physical entrance through which a user: Ingresso fisico attraverso cui si entra in un edificio o in una struttura.
it.#Gate or opening providing access to a p: Cancello o apertura che consente di accedere a un parco, campus o altro complesso.
it.#Street-level boarding or alighting poin: Punto a livello strada dove si sale o si scende da un servizio di trasporto pubblico di linea.
it.#Boarding area associated with one or mo: Area di attesa e salita associata a uno o più servizi di trasporto pubblico, di solito all'interno di una fermata o stazione.
it.#Street-level entrance providing access: Ingresso a livello strada che dà accesso a una stazione, alle sue banchine e ai suoi servizi.
it.#Access point leading to a ferry termina: Accesso che conduce a un terminal traghetti, molo o area d'imbarco.
it.#Taxi rank or pickup point: Posteggio taxi o punto di prelievo
it.#Fixed or designated location where user: Luogo fisso o indicato dove è possibile prendere un taxi o un altro servizio di trasporto su richiesta.
it.#Shared-mobility dock or pickup point: Stazione o punto di ritiro della mobilità condivisa
it.#Dock, station or designated location fo: Stazione, area o punto indicato per prendere o restituire veicoli condivisi.
it.#Vehicle or pedestrian entrance to a par: Ingresso per veicoli o pedoni a un parcheggio.
it.#Virtual DRT stop: Fermata virtuale per trasporto a chiamata (DRT)
it.#Designated non-physical or lightly mark: Punto di salita o discesa definito per il trasporto a chiamata, anche se non è presente una fermata fisica.
it.#Entrance or access node to a multimodal: Ingresso o punto di accesso a un hub o nodo di interscambio tra diversi mezzi di trasporto.
it.#Generic access interface used when no m: Punto di accesso generico usato quando non si applica un tipo più specifico.

fr.#Physical entrance through which a user: Entrée physique permettant d'accéder à un bâtiment ou à un équipement.
fr.#Park or compound gate: Entrée de parc ou de complexe
fr.#Gate or opening providing access to a p: Portail ou ouverture donnant accès à un parc, un campus ou un autre complexe.
fr.#Street-level boarding or alighting poin: Point au niveau de la rue où l'on monte ou descend d'un service de transport public régulier.
fr.#Boarding area associated with one or mo: Zone d'attente et d'embarquement liée à un ou plusieurs services de transport public, généralement dans un arrêt ou une gare.
fr.#Street-level entrance providing access: Entrée au niveau de la rue donnant accès à une gare ou station, à ses quais et à ses services.
fr.#Access point leading to a ferry termina: Accès menant à un terminal de ferry, un quai ou une zone d'embarquement.
fr.#Taxi rank or pickup point: Station de taxi ou point de prise en charge
fr.#Fixed or designated location where user: Lieu fixe ou désigné où l'on peut prendre un taxi ou un autre service de transport à la demande.
fr.#accessible taxi pickup: prise en charge en taxi accessible
fr.#Shared-mobility dock or pickup point: Station ou point de retrait de mobilité partagée
fr.#Dock, station or designated location fo: Station, zone ou point désigné pour prendre ou rendre un véhicule partagé.
fr.#Vehicle or pedestrian entrance to a par: Entrée pour véhicules ou piétons donnant accès à un parking.
fr.#Virtual DRT stop: Arrêt virtuel de transport à la demande (DRT)
fr.#Designated non-physical or lightly mark: Point de prise en charge ou de dépose défini pour le transport à la demande, même sans arrêt physique.
fr.#on-demand pickup point: point de prise en charge à la demande
fr.#Entrance or access node to a multimodal: Entrée ou point d'accès à un pôle multimodal ou à un lieu de correspondance entre plusieurs modes.
fr.#Generic access interface used when no m: Point d'accès générique utilisé lorsqu'aucun type plus précis ne convient.

de.#Physical entrance through which a user: Physischer Eingang, über den man ein Gebäude oder eine Einrichtung betritt.
de.#Gate or opening providing access to a p: Tor oder Öffnung, über die man einen Park, Campus oder ein anderes Gelände betritt.
de.#Street-level boarding or alighting poin: Ort auf Straßenniveau zum Ein- oder Aussteigen bei einem planmäßigen öffentlichen Verkehrsmittel.
de.#Boarding area associated with one or mo: Warte- und Einstiegsbereich für einen oder mehrere öffentliche Verkehrsdienste, meist innerhalb einer Haltestelle oder Station.
de.#Street-level entrance providing access: Eingang auf Straßenniveau zu einer Station oder einem Bahnhof und zu deren Bahnsteigen und Angeboten.
de.#Access point leading to a ferry termina: Zugang zu einem Fährterminal, Anleger oder Einstiegsbereich.
de.#Fixed or designated location where user: Fester oder ausgewiesener Ort, an dem man ein Taxi oder einen anderen Fahrdienst nutzen kann.
de.#Dock, station or designated location fo: Station oder ausgewiesener Ort zum Ausleihen oder Zurückgeben geteilter Fahrzeuge.
de.#Vehicle or pedestrian entrance to a par: Ein- oder Zugang für Fahrzeuge oder zu Fuß Gehende zu einer Parkanlage.
de.#Designated non-physical or lightly mark: Festgelegter Ein- oder Ausstiegspunkt für Bedarfsverkehr, auch wenn dort keine physische Haltestelle vorhanden ist.
de.#Entrance or access node to a multimodal: Eingang oder Zugang zu einem multimodalen Mobilitätsknoten oder Umsteigepunkt.
de.#Generic access interface used when no m: Allgemeiner Zugangspunkt, wenn kein genauerer Zugangstyp passt.

tr.#Physical entrance through which a user: Bir binaya veya tesise girmek için kullanılan fiziksel giriş.
tr.#Gate or opening providing access to a p: Bir parka, kampüse veya başka bir yerleşkeye erişim sağlayan kapı ya da açıklık.
tr.#Street-level boarding or alighting poin: Tarifeli bir toplu taşıma aracına binilen veya araçtan inilen sokak seviyesindeki nokta.
tr.#Boarding area associated with one or mo: Bir veya daha fazla toplu taşıma hizmeti için bekleme ve biniş alanı; genellikle bir durak veya istasyon içindedir.
tr.#Street-level entrance providing access: Bir istasyona, peronlarına ve hizmetlerine erişim sağlayan sokak seviyesindeki giriş.
tr.#Access point leading to a ferry termina: Feribot terminaline, iskeleye veya biniş alanına giden erişim noktası.
tr.#Taxi rank or pickup point: Taksi durağı veya yolcu alma noktası
tr.#Fixed or designated location where user: Taksi ya da başka bir çağrılı ulaşım hizmetine binmek için belirlenmiş sabit nokta.
tr.#Shared-mobility dock or pickup point: Paylaşımlı ulaşım istasyonu veya alma noktası
tr.#Dock, station or designated location fo: Paylaşımlı araçların alındığı veya bırakıldığı istasyon ya da belirlenmiş nokta.
tr.#Vehicle or pedestrian entrance to a par: Bir otoparka araçla veya yaya olarak giriş noktası.
tr.#Virtual DRT stop: Talebe bağlı ulaşım için sanal durak (DRT)
tr.#Designated non-physical or lightly mark: Fiziksel bir durak olmasa da talebe bağlı ulaşım için belirlenen yolcu alma veya indirme noktası.
tr.#Entrance or access node to a multimodal: Birden fazla ulaşım türünün buluştuğu ulaşım merkezine veya aktarma noktasına giriş.
tr.#Generic access interface used when no m: Daha özel bir erişim türü uygun olmadığında kullanılan genel erişim noktası.

fa.#Physical entrance through which a user: ورودی فیزیکی برای ورود به یک ساختمان یا مرکز.
fa.#Gate or opening providing access to a p: دروازه یا ورودی‌ای که دسترسی به پارک، پردیس یا مجموعه‌ای دیگر را فراهم می‌کند.
fa.#Street-level boarding or alighting poin: نقطه‌ای در سطح خیابان برای سوار یا پیاده شدن از خدمات منظم حمل‌ونقل عمومی.
fa.#Boarding area associated with one or mo: محل انتظار و سوار شدن برای یک یا چند خدمت حمل‌ونقل عمومی که معمولاً داخل ایستگاه قرار دارد.
fa.#Street-level entrance providing access: ورودی در سطح خیابان که دسترسی به ایستگاه، سکوها و خدمات آن را فراهم می‌کند.
fa.#Access point leading to a ferry termina: ورودی یا مسیری که به پایانه کشتی، اسکله یا محل سوار شدن می‌رسد.
fa.#Taxi rank or pickup point: ایستگاه تاکسی یا محل سوار شدن
fa.#Fixed or designated location where user: محل ثابت یا مشخصی برای سوار شدن به تاکسی یا خدمات حمل‌ونقل درخواستی.
fa.#accessible taxi pickup: محل سوار شدن به تاکسی قابل دسترس
fa.#Shared-mobility dock or pickup point: ایستگاه یا محل دریافت وسیله اشتراکی
fa.#Dock, station or designated location fo: ایستگاه یا محل مشخص برای گرفتن یا پس دادن وسایل نقلیه اشتراکی.
fa.#Vehicle or pedestrian entrance to a par: ورودی خودرو یا عابر پیاده به یک پارکینگ.
fa.#Designated non-physical or lightly mark: محل مشخص برای سوار یا پیاده شدن در حمل‌ونقل درخواستی، حتی اگر ایستگاه فیزیکی وجود نداشته باشد.
fa.#Entrance or access node to a multimodal: ورودی یا نقطه دسترسی به یک مرکز چندوجهی یا محل تعویض وسیله نقلیه.
fa.#Generic access interface used when no m: نقطه دسترسی کلی که وقتی نوع مشخص‌تری مناسب نیست استفاده می‌شود.

hu.#Physical entrance through which a user: Fizikai bejárat, amelyen keresztül egy épületbe vagy létesítménybe lehet belépni.
hu.#Gate or opening providing access to a p: Kapu vagy nyílás, amelyen keresztül parkba, kampuszra vagy más területre lehet belépni.
hu.#Street-level boarding or alighting poin: Utcaszinti hely, ahol menetrend szerinti közösségi közlekedési járműre lehet felszállni vagy arról leszállni.
hu.#Boarding area associated with one or mo: Egy vagy több közösségi közlekedési járathoz tartozó várakozó- és felszállóhely, általában megállón vagy állomáson belül.
hu.#Street-level entrance providing access: Utcaszinti bejárat, amelyen keresztül elérhető az állomás, annak peronjai és szolgáltatásai.
hu.#Access point leading to a ferry termina: Kompterminálhoz, kikötőhöz vagy beszállóhelyhez vezető bejárat.
hu.#Fixed or designated location where user: Rögzített vagy kijelölt hely, ahol taxit vagy más igény szerinti fuvarszolgáltatást lehet igénybe venni.
hu.#Shared-mobility dock or pickup point: Megosztott járművek állomása vagy átvételi pontja
hu.#Dock, station or designated location fo: Állomás vagy kijelölt hely megosztott járművek felvételére vagy leadására.
hu.#Vehicle or pedestrian entrance to a par: Járműves vagy gyalogos bejárat egy parkolóba.
hu.#Designated non-physical or lightly mark: Igényvezérelt közlekedéshez kijelölt fel- vagy leszállóhely akkor is, ha nincs fizikai megálló.
hu.#Entrance or access node to a multimodal: Bejárat vagy hozzáférési pont egy többféle közlekedési módot összekapcsoló csomóponthoz.
hu.#Generic access interface used when no m: Általános hozzáférési pont arra az esetre, ha nincs megfelelőbb, pontosabb típus.

ar.#Physical entrance through which a user: مدخل فعلي يُستخدم للدخول إلى مبنى أو مرفق.
ar.#Gate or opening providing access to a p: بوابة أو فتحة تتيح الدخول إلى حديقة أو حرم أو مجمع آخر.
ar.#Street-level boarding or alighting poin: نقطة على مستوى الشارع للصعود إلى وسيلة نقل عام مجدولة أو النزول منها.
ar.#Boarding area associated with one or mo: منطقة انتظار وصعود مرتبطة بخدمة أو أكثر من خدمات النقل العام، وعادة تكون داخل محطة أو موقف.
ar.#Street-level entrance providing access: مدخل على مستوى الشارع يتيح الوصول إلى المحطة وأرصفتها وخدماتها.
ar.#Access point leading to a ferry termina: مدخل يؤدي إلى محطة عبّارات أو رصيف أو منطقة صعود.
ar.#Fixed or designated location where user: مكان ثابت أو محدد يمكن منه ركوب سيارة أجرة أو خدمة نقل عند الطلب.
ar.#accessible taxi pickup: نقطة ركوب تاكسي مهيأة لسهولة الوصول
ar.#Shared-mobility dock or pickup point: محطة أو نقطة استلام للمركبات المشتركة
ar.#Dock, station or designated location fo: محطة أو مكان محدد لاستلام المركبات المشتركة أو إعادتها.
ar.#Vehicle or pedestrian entrance to a par: مدخل للمركبات أو للمشاة إلى مرفق لوقوف السيارات.
ar.#Designated non-physical or lightly mark: نقطة محددة للصعود أو النزول في خدمة النقل حسب الطلب، حتى لو لم يوجد موقف فعلي.
ar.#Entrance or access node to a multimodal: مدخل أو نقطة وصول إلى مركز متعدد وسائل النقل أو نقطة تبديل بين وسائل مختلفة.
ar.#Generic access interface used when no m: نقطة وصول عامة تُستخدم عندما لا ينطبق نوع أكثر تحديدًا.
